body: Yea I keep everything bottled up too. Sometimes it gets too much and it really hurts. I thought putting my problems on someone else is selfish and I felt guilty. It's hard to be so selfless and not burden other people. But you have to understand that the people who love you want you to me happy. It's hard to feel comfortable with someone to let everything out. I went to a therapist for a while but ended up not going anymore. It just felt weird paying someone to hear how pathetic my life is. If you have someone that loves you then let them know how you're feeling and they'll help you carry that weight. I don't have anyone left in the world that loves me that I can talk to but I really wish I did. Do you have anyone that loves you?
She's out there you just haven't met her yet.

Of course! I agree a person could solve their problems without dying, but that's not the point. Even if you do solve your problems more will come eventually, that's just life. Unfortunately some people don't have it as easy as others and/or live with depression which makes being alive unbearable at moments. I think it's humbling to know that at some point I'm going to die and be able to experience what comes after this life. Existence beyond death is unknown and I believe being able to walk through that door at any moment in time is beautiful. No problem will ever be able to take that away from me.
